title: Carry (some) packet options with wtap rec
description:
Mostly functioning proof-of-concept for #14329 presented
here for feedback. This work is intended to allow Wireshark to support
multiple packet comments per packet.

Uses and expands upon the `wtap_block` API in
`wiretap/wtap_opttypes.h`. It attaches a `wtap_block` structure to
`wtap_rec` in place of its current `opt_comment` and `packet_verdict`
members to hold OPT_COMMENT and OPT_PKT_VERDICT option values.

I believe this is now complete, with the following caveats:

* sharkd support is basic; it only allows adding comments, not replacing or removing them.
* the Lua API supports multiple comments, but does not reflect changes made to packets by the user using the GUI.

Closes #14329

[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/2859/diffs?diff_id=208621542&start_sha=cef88a6be0092351e438896342dea7cdddd48416)

> It attaches a `wtap_block` structure to `wtap_rec`

...which means that *all* of the packet options should be carried in the `wtap_rec`.  `pcapng_process_packet_block_option()` should handle *all* options by adding them to the block options array.

The fields that duplicate options should be removed from the `wtap_packet_header` structure; code that refers to them should fetch them from the option array.

If you like the approach, and think it doesn't lose efficiency from having dedicated structures, then I'm willing to do that as a second pass. I'd like to get the current implementation merged first if that's alright, to reduce the amount of conflicting/redundant changes happening while `pcapng.c` is seeing a fair bit of change lately anyway.

I fixed my memory leaks, so I think the only remaining blockers to this being merge-ready are the changes to the Lua API.

This should probably be called `frames_edited_blocks` or `frames_changed_blocks`; "user_comments" is a bit redundant, as many unmodified comments were added by users, and a Lua script could conceivably modify comments.

commits_data.title: Use wtap_blocks for packet comments
commits_data.message:
Use wtap_blocks for packet comments

Mostly functioning proof of concept for #14329. This work is intended to
allow Wireshark to support multiple packet comments per packet.

Uses and expands upon the `wtap_block` API in `wiretap/wtap_opttypes.h`.
It attaches a `wtap_block` structure to `wtap_rec` in place of its
current `opt_comment` and `packet_verdict` members to hold OPT_COMMENT
and OPT_PKT_VERDICT option values.
